title: Reconstruct native vector operator vtables and evaluation-mode ABI
question: Does every native BEE vector evaluator share a vtable +0x18 mode gate and reference-counted class layout?
observed_result: 20/20 native classes in both installed AE2025/26 have a primary and +24 secondary vftable; 9 mode0 group/shape/graphic gates and 11 mode1 filter gates; exact RTTI base hierarchies recorded.
limits: No third-party class instantiated or registered
Mode values inferred from machine code, not public enum
Native ABI validity and renderer integration unproven
